text_sections.text:
＜Barrier＞ ＜Evade＞ ＜Decode (Lv.5 or lower w/[Aqua]/[Sea Animal] in any trait or w/[TB] trait)＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 level 6 or lower card with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits or the [TB] trait from your hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, 1 of your Digimon may unsuspend.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon are played or digivolve, 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't activate [When Digivolving] effects or suspend until their turn ends.
(Rule) Trait: Has [Aquatic] Type.

qa.answer:
Yes, both have to be on XX.
For example, if text reads "level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [CS] trait or is yellow or black," it refers to a level 4 or lower Digimon card that has the [CS] trait or a level 4 or lower Digimon card that is yellow or black.
qa.question: If text reads "XX with AA or BB," do both AA and BB have to be on XX?
Does this card's [All Turns] effect also trigger when this card itself is played or when one of my Digimon in the battle area would digivolve into this card?

qa.answer: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.
qa.question: Multiple effects trigger when this card is played. In what order do they activate?

qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
When this card's DP becomes 0 and it would be deleted by a rule check, its and will trigger simultaneously. You can activate , play a Digimon, activate , prevent the deletion, then activate this card's again when it would be deleted by the next rule check. If the played Digimon has [On Play] effects, once all processing has been resolved for the rule checks, those [On Play] effects will trigger simultaneously.
qa.question:
I activated to play a Digimon when this card's DP became 0 and it would be deleted, then I activated , and it was prevented from being deleted.
If this card's DP is still 0 after that and it would be deleted, can I activate again?
When this card would be deleted, can I first activate to prevent the deletion, then activate to play a card from digivolution cards?

qa.answer:
This effect prevents [When Digivolving] effects on cards from activating.
[When Digivolving] effects can no longer activate by triggering or when effects such as "activate that card's [When Digivolving]" effect" activate.
qa.question: What does "[When Digivolving] effects don't activate" mean, exactly?

qa.answer:
Yes, you can.
The effect can activate if it activates upon the [When Attacking] timing.
qa.question:
I used a card affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" to attack.
Can I activate that card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect at such times?
If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can other effects activate its [When Digivolving] effect?
If a card is affected by "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects," can I process just the "by" condition in its [When Digivolving] effect?

qa.answer:
No, it doesn't count.
The effect can't activate upon the [When Digivolving] timing, therefore it doesn't count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn].
qa.question:
A card that was given "can't activate [When Digivolving] effects" digivolved into a card that has a [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] effect.
Does that count as an instance of that effect's [X Per Turn] even if that effect can't be activated upon the timing when that card digivolved?
